title: Rabbi Elazar of Ruma
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Gittin 67b](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.67b.3): Rabbi Yohanan speaks in the name of Rabbi Elazar of Ruma; and so it is in [the Jerusalem Talmud there, at the end of chapter 6](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Gittin.6.7.4).[^1]

notes.text: Both versions give the same line of transmission, which [Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=533&lang=en) also records. The Bavli reads Ruma and speaks of enumerating the agents. The Jerusalem Talmud reads Roma and has the verb “awards.”
